# brig service attach

Give a sandbox a token for a service

## Synopsis

```text
brig service attach SERVICE [VM] SANDBOX
```

## Description

Give a ready sandbox of a VM a token of its own for a service. The VM
defaults to the one that [`brig use`](brig-use.md) selected, and the workspace to the one
that -w or BRIG\_WORKSPACE names, else default.

brig mints the token, hands the service its hash, and stores the token as
the provider brig-svc-SERVICE-SANDBOX of the gateway, with a profile
brig-svc-SERVICE that brig generates, attached to the sandbox. Programs
that the sandbox starts afterwards find a placeholder in the variables that
[`brig service show`](brig-service-show.md) lists; OpenShell puts the token in its place when one of
the service's callers sends a request to the service's URL.

## Examples

```sh
brig service attach mirror dev webapp
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-w, --workspace string` | the workspace of the gateway to work in (default: $BRIG\_WORKSPACE, else default) |

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.
